text:
jia: quick sync 1: opened a PR to tighten up the "tier" examples in the metering guide. includes a compact SDK snippet, a curl alternative, and a tiny grafana target for the usage dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5189

matt: glanced at it. nice work. two small asks: show the Authorization header explicitly and use ISO timestamps in examples. also prefer the word "breakdown" in examples to match the API.

elaine: +1 to matt. also can we show a sample response shape (trimmed) so folks know what keys to expect? a one-line JSON sample is fine.

jia: agree on the response sample. draft snippets below (kept minimal):

```python
# SDK v4: query usage breakdown by tier
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.usage.query(
    start="2026-02-01T00:00:00Z",
    end="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
    breakdown="tier",
    filters={"product": "embedding-service"}
)
print(resp.metrics)
# -> [{"tier": "startup", "tokens": 123456}, {"tier": "enterprise", "tokens": 98765}]
```

```bash
# curl equivalent (header shown explicitly)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"embedding-service"}}'
```

leo: here's a tiny grafana target snippet you can drop into the panel example (just title + targets):

```json
{"title":"Tokens by tier","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (tier) (redwood_usage_tokens_total{product=\"embedding-service\"})","legendFormat":"{{tier}}"}]}
```

sanjay: pls add an FAQ note that tiered credits are prorated to the second and charges are rounded at billing run. also mention that reserved capacity credits are consumed before on-demand credits for the same customer id. saves support churn.

elaine: for the sample response can you include units (tokens) and clarify whether ephemeral system tokens are excluded? small sentence under the code sample will help.

jia: added a one-line response example in the SDK snippet and an extra sentence: "system and ephemeral tokens filtered from public usage queries by default." also added the FAQ bullet about prorating and reserved-first consumption.

docs-bot: PR updated: jia pushed 3 commits to docs/metering-tier-examples at 1765440120 1 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5189/files

product-qa: running quick verification: curl returns 200 and matches the sample shape, SDK snippet runs in a clean env. grafana target renders sample series in dev grafana.

matt: lgtm. will merge after CI. thanks for tightening the wording and adding the daily billing note.

jia: thanks all! merging once CI green :rocket:
